deep.reconstruction: This page contains no mathematics and no handwriting by Riemann. It is page 5 of a printed German antiquarian bookseller's sale catalogue, section 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik'. It lists second-hand books alphabetically from Büffon to Engelbrecht. For each item it gives author, short title, format, place, year (abbreviated without the leading 1, e.g. 772 = 1772), binding and price in Thaler and Silbergroschen; a bracketed price in parentheses is the original publication price. The previous and next pages (4 and 6) are consecutive pages of the same catalogue. One entry is dated 1862 (Crüger, Schule der Physik), so the catalogue was printed in 1862 or later. That is within Riemann's lifetime, but the sheet may simply have been filed in the Nachlass bundle. There are no derivations to reconstruct. The only arithmetic is prices, which are not computations by the author.

transcription_corrections: The currency symbol rendered as '₰' (Pfennig) is in the print the Thaler sign (Fraktur abbreviation); the next page's transcription uses 'ℛ' for the same symbol.
'Deux Ponto' should read 'Deux Ponts' (Zweibrücken edition of Buffon).
'Φατοβασανος' is Colonna's 'Φυτοβάσανος' (Phytobasanos); 'Lynceon notit.' refers to the Lincei (Lynceorum).
'Kittl.' abbreviates Kittlitz (place of publication of Curie's Anleitung, ed. Lüben).
'in partical.' in the Clare entry stands for 'in particular'.
'H. J. N.' in the Crantz entry is printed 'H. J. N.' (Heinrich Johann Nepomuk von Crantz); the image letter could be read 'B'/'H' but H is correct.
'Cüvier' and 'Büffon' are spelled with umlauts in the print, as transcribed (period spelling).
